On Friday, our Under the Radar Moversnewsletter suggested small cap health insurance stock Connecture Inc (NASDAQ: CNXR) as a short-term buy:
As for Connecture, everything changed for the better two weeks ago with the cross above the 200-day moving average line (green) on huge volume. The only problem with that particular move was simply that it was too much, and unfurled too fast. Sure enough, the stock peeled back the bulk of this week, bleeding off some of the overbought pressure. The bulls still tipped their hand, however, and we’re going to take the hint because today it looks like the bigger uptrend started two weeks ago has been renewed.
Just as important, there’s a flood of volume flowing back in today on the way up; we love second-wind efforts, since they tend to last. Top 5 Insurance Stocks To Own For 2019: Prudential Financial Inc.( PRU )
Advisors’ Opinion: [By Chuck Saletta]
Prudential Financial (NYSE: PRU ) takes such pride in its rock-solid financial condition that it uses an actual rock — the Rock of Gibraltar– as its corporate symbol. Prudential Financial backs up that claim with a balance sheet that has more cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investmentsthan total debt on it. It also claims a debt-to-equity ratio around 0.6 and a current ratio around 1.0, which are further signs of a solid financial condition. [By Zacks]
